regime_context: Canada/TSX thematic state shows a broad, non-directional rotation (breadth 0.5, one_narrative false) led by Silver & Royalties and Gold Miners in a tight two-theme precious-metals complex, with momentum rank acting as a focus lens only (rank-IC ~0). The absolute-trend gate does help drawdown control on this market (gate_helps true), so eligible-theme direction reads are permissible as conditional leans, but backtest direction accuracy is poor (0.312), mandating low conviction.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Gold Miners closes the 0.034 score gap with Silver & Royalties and becomes the rotation leader — I would retire this watch if the gap widens back above 0.10 over the next 10 trading days.

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: The top-ranked theme is eligible, scorable via XGD.TO, shows high durability (0.69) and full breadth (1.0), and is not crowded. It leads the precious-metals cluster with Gold Miners close behind, suggesting the narrative is a coherent PM-complex story rather than an idiosyncratic silver spike. The absolute-trend gate (the one validated edge here) keeps this in the stay-long remit.
evidence: rank 1 with score 2.127 and eligible true
theses.dissent: The margin over Gold Miners is tiny (0.034) and rotation is non-directional (directional false), so the leadership is fragile and could hand off to Gold Miners on any silver-specific reversal; Hurst 'mixed' means momentum persistence is not mechanically assured.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX composite over any rolling 10-day window for the next two weeks without a corresponding PM-complex pullback

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Second-ranked and also eligible with the highest durability_bar in the ranks (0.73) and full breadth. It is essentially tied with the leader (score 2.093 vs 2.127), so the PM trade is really a composite read on both. Keeping it as overweight rather than flat reflects the coherent top-of-rotation cluster.
evidence: rank 2 with score 2.093 and eligible true
scorable via XGD.TO (same proxy, so highly correlated with Silver & Royalties)
theses.dissent: Sharing the XGD.TO proxy means any conviction in Gold Miners is almost fully redundant with the Silver & Royalties lean; treating both as overweight effectively doubles the same PM-complex exposure with no diversification benefit.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO prints consecutive lower highs versus the S&P/TSX composite over the next 15 trading days

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Rank 4 but the only eligible theme flagged as crowded (crowding_z 1.29, crowded true). Per the guardrails, crowding is a cap/down-size caution only, never a fade or short — so the honest expression is a relative underweight leaning toward avoidance, expressed as a direction only. The absolute-trend gate on this market helps cut drawdown, so being underweight a crowded leader-adjacent group is defensible risk discipline.
evidence: rank 4 with score 1.13 and eligible true
crowding_z 1.29 and crowded true (the only eligible crowded theme)
guardrails require crowding be treated as a down-size caution, not a fade
theses.dissent: Energy momentum in Canada can be persistent and reflexive; crowding flags have historically marked attention spikes, not reliable tops, and underweighting a still-eligible trend theme with 0.68 durability may forgo further upside if crude stays bid.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO makes a new 20-day high and the crowding flag clears below 1.0

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
